claims.text: Grand Hyatt Mumbai is set across 12 acres of landscaped gardens in Santacruz.

findings.quote: Set across 12 acres of lush, landscaped gardens, Grand Hyatt Mumbai is an urban oasis in Santacruz
findings.note: Confirms 12 acres of landscaped gardens in Santacruz.

claims.text: The Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre and Jio World Drive are in nearby BKC.

findings.quote: Right in BKC, discover inspiring performances at the Nita Mukesh Ambani Cultural Centre (NMACC) and indulge in shopping and dining at Jio World Drive.
findings.note: Both venues are placed in BKC near the hotel.

claims.text: Guestrooms have a marble bathroom.

findings.quote: Recharge in a contemporary guestroom featuring a plush king bed, elegant marble bathroom, and refined interiors

claims.text: Courtyard View rooms look out over the hotel's courtyard.

findings.quote: Wake up to calming views of the hotel's lush courtyard from this inviting room with twin beds.
findings.note: Describes the 2 Twin Beds, Courtyard View room.

claims.text: The serviced apartments have fully equipped kitchens for short and extended stays.

findings.quote: a fully equipped contemporary kitchen designed for both short and extended stays
findings.note: Stated for the One-Bedroom Apartment; other apartments list kitchens or kitchenettes.

claims.text: The Presidential Suite includes butler service.

findings.quote: Thoughtful butler service completes an exceptional luxury experience.
findings.note: Stated in the Presidential Suite description.

claims.text: The Grand Club lounge is open to Club room and suite guests.

findings.quote: Experience opulence at the private and exclusive Grand Club lounge, accessible to Club room and suite guests.
findings.note: Confirms access for Club room and suite guests.

claims.text: The Grand Club offers private breakfast, high tea and cocktail hours.

findings.quote: Indulge in a private breakfast, high-tea, cocktail hours, or boardroom facilities.
findings.note: Lists private breakfast, high tea and cocktail hours.

claims.text: The pool has a dedicated poolside bar.

findings.quote: Choose from our refreshing cocktails and mocktails at the dedicated poolside bar

claims.text: The Club Oasis Fitness Centre has a fully equipped gym and personal trainers.

findings.quote: featuring a fully equipped gymnasium, personal trainers, and innovative exercise programs
findings.note: Describes the Club Oasis Fitness Centre.

claims.text: China House has served Sichuan cuisine in Mumbai for over two decades.

findings.quote: For over two decades, China House has defined authentic Sichuan dining in Mumbai
findings.note: Confirms over two decades of Sichuan cuisine.

claims.text: LOOKS Salon at the hotel offers hair, beauty, nail and grooming services.

findings.quote: LOOKS Salon at Grand Hyatt Mumbai offers a premium salon experience with expert hair, beauty, nail, and grooming services in an elegant setting.
findings.note: Lists hair, beauty, nail and grooming services.

claims.text: The Verandah Suite has an expansive private verandah with views of the hotel's green landscapes and the Mumbai skyline.

findings.quote: Take in sweeping views of the hotel's green landscapes and the Mumbai skyline from your expansive private verandah.

claims.text: Every serviced apartment at Grand Hyatt Mumbai Residences has access to a private swimming pool area and its own entry and lobby.

findings.quote: Every luxurious apartment—whether one, two or three bedrooms—has access to a private swimming pool area, exclusive entry, lobby, parking, security
findings.note: Confirms private pool area, exclusive entry and lobby for every apartment.

claims.text: An outdoor pool and a children's pool are on the banquet level.

findings.quote: Located on the banquet level, our alluring outdoor pool and children’s pool offers an ideal excuse to leave your room.
findings.note: Confirms an outdoor pool and a children's pool on the banquet level.

claims.text: Club Oasis, the spa on the banquet level, offers spa treatments designed to rejuvenate.

findings.quote: Experience the wonders of a well-rested body and mind with our blissful treatment options at the banquet-level Club Oasis, designed to rejuvenate you.
findings.note: Confirms banquet-level spa treatments designed to rejuvenate.

claims.text: The Magic Table is a dinner experience by mentalists Thommy Ten and Amelie van Tass, with immersive 3D projections, illusion and a five-course dinner.

findings.quote: Created by world-renowned mentalists Thommy Ten & Amélie van Tass: The Clairvoyants, The Magic Table unfolds through immersive 3D projections, illusion and unexpected interactions, paired with a specially curated 5-course dinner.
findings.note: Covers the creators, 3D projections, illusion and five-course dinner.

claims.text: A taxi to the international airport's Terminal 2 takes about 15 to 25 minutes, depending on traffic.

findings.quote: Travel Time: 15–25 minutes (subject to traffic). Availability: 24 hours from both International (T2) and Domestic (T1) terminals.
findings.note: Taxi option listed under the International Airport (Terminal 2).

claims.text: Children under 16 and pets are not allowed in the Grand Club.

findings.quote: Kids below 16 years and pets are strictly not allowed.
findings.note: Stated in the Grand Club description.

claims.text: WhataHotel notes the business-focused location may lack tourist attractions nearby.
